400831501.text: Traveler, Paimon. This day has come earlier than I had expected.

400831502.text: My apologies, but my writing career is at stake here, and my reputation in Lady Yae's eyes... I can't allow you to beat me.

400831504.text: Don't get too cocky, Souka! We won't go easy on you!

400831701.text: I can't believe it... I lost, that's it... *sigh*

400831702.text: It seems that the "Guests of Tenshukaku" have powers beyond the reach of mere mortals like me.

400831703.text: Oh no, did we go too far? Souka's taking this pretty hard... Miko said it was fine to not hold back, but she'll definitely be mad at us when she sees her in this state...

400831704.text: Paimon's freaking out... Okay, we should just go apologize to Miko. C'mon, Bongo-Head, put on your best guilty face!

400831401.text: This all looks like regular Floral Jelly. It's right out in the open for everyone to see, and they've even put the recipe on the table.

400831404.text: Hmm... Well, it's not like we can just take them away and go investigate them. That'd be stealing, right? We'd probably be disqualified, and might even end up getting arrested by the Corps of Thirty.

400831405.text: Oh, but... we do have a Kamera! How about we take some pictures of the Floral Jelly and its recipe? At least then, we'll have a record of all the important information.

400830501.text: Miko, we're sorry! It was all Bongo-Head! We didn't know it would take Souka out so quickly...

400830504.text: Oh? Did she look crestfallen and say something melodramatic like "beyond the reach of mere mortals"? Then curl up on the ground and start wailing?

400830505.text: Uh yes... to all of those, actually. You know her really well, huh...

400830506.text: It's better this way. Souka will turn this experience into valuable writing material. She'll be able to portray the protagonist's journey with all the setbacks they face along the way much more compellingly. It will resonate all the more with readers.

400830507.text: As for how to flesh out the villain — dominating, ruthless, but brilliant, and ultimately victorious — the inspiration will have to come from you. So don't go getting yourselves knocked out of the competition by some second-rate wannabe, hm?

subQuests.subQuestName: Wait till early morning the next day (3:00 – 5:00)
Go to the Floral Jelly vendor
Take photos of the shop to use as evidence

400831801.text: Impossible... My team has been defeated...?

400831802.text: Phew, that was a hard-won battle... You and your buddies put up a good fight, Bongo-Head!

400831901.text: You locate the Floral Jelly and recipe, and take photo evidence...

400831902.text: Done! We should ask an expert to analyze these photos... But we're kinda running out of time. Let's go buy Layla's stuff first!

400831904.text: You hold yourselves to pretty high standards, coming here so early to power-up your Fungi. No wonder you've made it this far.

400831905.text: Haniyyah, we need to talk! Your plan you told us about last time, it's way too extreme...

400831906.text: Save your breath. If you think I'm wrong, start by defeating me. Then you can show me why exactly you think your opinion is correct.

400831907.text: She won't listen to us at all... How did things end up like this? Paimon thought we were getting along pretty well at first!

400831910.text: Alright, fine... Come on, Bongo-Head, there's no time to mope.

400830901.text: Layla's note says that this is where we should be meeting the Almighty Merchant...

400830902.text: The looks on your faces tell me you're searching for the Almighty Merchant, yes? Welcome, welcome!

400830904.text: Wait, Dori? Ah, so you're the Almighty Merchant Layla mentioned?

400830905.text: Why so surprised? Every vendor and customer in the Grand Bazaar knows that Lord Sangemah Bay possesses the widest and most magical range of goods.

400830906.text: "Almighty," "supreme," "omnipotent"... These and many more are my exclusive epithets. Any other merchant thinking of using one can forget it... unless they're prepared to pay millions of Mora in licensing fees!

400830908.text: Yeah yeah, whatever, but back to business. I'm surprised that Layla sent you here on her behalf... I suppose she must be busy enjoying the beast-tamers tournament, hmm?

400830909.text: Sounds like you two get along pretty well. You know a lot about what's going on!

400830910.text: Hehe, it has nothing to do with getting along. Layla previously bought a few things from me. They weren't the most valuable goods, but it was still a lot of Mora — for a student.

400830911.text: So naturally, I now keep tabs on her activity. Which is why I know that she's taking part in a very suspicious tournament!

400830914.text: Mm-hmm. Something just didn't feel right. As it happens, I do have some goods I'm trying to get off my hands — they're a little hot for my liking, but so far, no takers... They're also taking up space. So I think I'll just give them to you.

400830915.text: Umm... This is just a bunch of spare parts and random notes...

400830916.text: I'm told that this is a device and some documents that the organizer attempted to destroy.

400830917.text: But they were careless. Some people will scavenge through anything hoping for a chance to get rich. Sure enough, someone fished these out of the water and sent them to me.

400830918.text: Now that Paimon takes a closer look, this looks similar to the recipe for Floral Jelly. And these parts look like they came from a Wisdom Orb.

400830919.text: Maybe they were used during the experiment phase? Let's hold onto them for now and have Miko take a look later. Maybe she'll notice if there's anything fishy about them.

400831601.text: I can see you're serious about this. Good. Time to put my years of rigorous training to full use.

400831602.text: Now, prepare to witness the power of my all-Cryo Fungi team!

400831301.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon, I saw you guys made it to the next round. Congrats!

400831302.text: Hey, Layla! You're looking well today, and Twirly-Whirly looks really happy! Guess you won your last round, too?

400831303.text: It was a close call, I only won by a hair... I'm so glad I trained with Miss Yae beforehand.

400831304.text: Also, the Almighty Merchant just sent someone to deliver the stuff I ordered. Thank you so much! I'm gonna go catch up on some rest with Twirly-Whirly now...

400831305.text: *whine*... My stamina's running low... Let's keep the volume down.

400831306.text: Speaking of Miss Yae... where'd Miko go?

400831307.text: She left in a hurry with Souka. I guess they must have had something urgent to do. Also, I think they were escorted by a mercenary from the Corps of Thirty...

400831308.text: When I returned to the arena, they were already quite a distance away. It didn't feel right to run after them and ask what they were up to...

400831311.text: Could be. Miko has been putting a lot of time into the tournament lately, so Paimon wouldn't be surprised if she had a lot of Chief Editor work to catch up on.

400831312.text: She also said that she wanted to look for inspiration while enjoying her vacation. The mercenary was probably just their tour guide. We shouldn't worry about it!

400831313.text: The quarterfinals are coming up. To me, this is the most important round... I'm a little nervous, but let's all do our best!

400831314.text: Yeah! We've all done really well to come this far in the tournament. Keep it up, Layla!
